privacyIntro.message: ReverseIMG is built to keep your searches private.

privacyDataBody.message: Nothing. ReverseIMG has no accounts, analytics, advertising, or developer servers.

privacyLocalBody.message: Settings and recent searches stay in Firefox local storage. Temporary image data stays in IndexedDB for up to 15 minutes and is deleted automatically.

privacyThirdPartyBody.message: When you start a search, your image or query is sent directly to the search engine you choose. That engine's privacy policy applies.

privacyNoTrackingBody.message: ReverseIMG does not track you, profile you, or sell data.

privacyPermissionsBody.message: ReverseIMG requests only menus, storage, activeTab, and scripting. menus adds the right-click items, storage saves your settings and recent searches, activeTab reads the image you explicitly right-clicked, and scripting reads blob: image data after you choose a search. ReverseIMG does not request host permissions and does not read pages in the background.

privacyDeclarationBody.message: The add-on declares searchTerms and websiteContent to Mozilla Add-ons. These categories describe data sent directly to the search engine you choose. The developer does not receive or retain it.

privacyRetentionBody.message: Recent searches stay until you clear them or uninstall the extension. Temporary image entries are removed after the upload handoff or after 15 minutes. Settings stay until you reset them or uninstall. The developer has no server-side data to delete.

privacyChildrenBody.message: ReverseIMG is a general-purpose search utility and is not directed at children. It does not knowingly collect personal information from anyone.

privacyChangesBody.message: If this policy changes, the updated version will be published in the project repository and the extension privacy page, with a new date. Material changes may also be noted in the release notes.

privacyScopeBody.message: This policy applies to the ReverseIMG Firefox extension and its bundled pages. It does not apply to the websites of Google, Microsoft, Yandex, TinEye, SauceNAO, DuckDuckGo, Brave, Mozilla, GitHub, or any other third party.

privacyContactBody.message: Questions? Contact matthew on GitHub at https://github.com/shuriv.

privacyEnglishNote.message: The English privacy policy in the source repository is the canonical version and governs if there is a conflict.
